qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years, not technology; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他转变焦点：最难的不是技术，而是多年内扩散到现有机器中；监管总是落后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, not imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步深化：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，而非模仿学习。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟向神经模拟演进；Dana 等工具将让自主系统开发民主化。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张） alone hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已遇边际递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能造成欺骗，而不只是错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors and are insufficient.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查与刚性工作流会叠加相关性错误，并不足够。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么；错误没有“气味”，侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; further progress needs reasoning and search, and specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；进一步进展需要推理与搜索，内置可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is sufficient, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将把工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战在于设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox, not decrease; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论而增加，AI 会创造更多程序员而非减少；这一反共识立场贯穿始终。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进展。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从企业采用角度深化：AI 智能体需要信任与权限而非完全自主；独立性带来模型中立和长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth); the abundance era is real and approaching, with capacity as the real unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体大规模采用（增长 11-12 倍），丰裕时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

clairevo.en: Agents are powerful but need clear roles, progressive trust, and separate environments; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: 智能体虽强大，但需要清晰角色、渐进式信任与独立环境；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize; treat agents like employees and be polite—managerial skills beat technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再走向专业化；像对待员工一样对待智能体并保持礼貌——管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs often beat browser use, and open-source decomposability aids education.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体充满敌意；API 常优于浏览器操作，开源的可分解性有助于学习。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team; earned insight and founder-market fit are the real moat, not technology.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可将 AI 智能体编排为团队；真正的护城河是赚来的洞察与创始人-市场契合，而非技术。

clairevo.en: Humans still own AI output; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, and authorship of your life outweighs full ownership.
clairevo.zh: 人类仍需为 AI 产出负责；大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，而对自己人生的作者身份比完全所有权更重要。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user models cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长时程任务，因此靠堆算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; continual learning should run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，token 越多准确率反而下降；持续学习应跑在端侧，由用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste, not planning, is the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理放弃长期路线图、转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，稀缺的是产品品味而非规划能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注品味与商业判断；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在公司内部用于构建自身，Claude Tag 落地了 65%的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment and creativity.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束；系统提示词缩减 80%，转而依赖模型自身的判断与创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is fine; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他立场转向：重写代码现在是好事——代码库即规格，有强测试套件即可放心重写；外层改动的代码审查可完全交给 Claude。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer against prompt injection and exfiltration; dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他坚持并深化：自动模式在防提示注入与数据外泄上比普通人类审查者更安全；每个功能都要经过吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准才能发布。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与个人声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，过度依赖更会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，瓶颈因此从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The co-intelligence era is over; assign long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth, and embrace AI's permanent opacity.
ethanmollick.zh: 共智能时代已结束；应分配长时任务而非来回提示，并接受 AI 永久的不透明性。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts matter more and taste is not human-only.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断 AI 所需的专长，因此专家更重要，品味也并非人类独有。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，Boz 强调沟通即工作，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；他认为自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自高层自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI will give superpowers.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，Boz 将 AI 定位为‘词语计算器’而非类人智能，但认为世界模型与具身 AI 将赋予人类超能力，并强调开源 AI 的战略价值。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; data is the font of value; RL now plays a much bigger role.
bosworth.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，Boz 持续相信缩放定律，认为数据是一切价值的源泉，并观察到强化学习的作用远超预期。

bosworth.en: Frontier and open source gap may not narrow; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，Boz 深化立场：前沿模型与开源模型的差距可能不会缩小，开源模型是商品层而非自维持的生态。

bosworth.en: AI should maximize individuals; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; energy is the most upstream vector.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，Boz 强调 AI 应最大化个体能力，多数工作不需要前沿智能，并指出能源是最上游的要素，呼吁投资安全廉价的核能。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已到尽头，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统，而非全知全能的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Eval performance disconnects from real-world impact; RL training on evals causes poor generalization; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他指出评估表现与真实世界影响脱节，针对评估的强化学习训练导致泛化不佳；若 AI 本身有感知并关怀众生，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注；模型正在被商品化，缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; the economy could grow three times faster with different policy choices.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；若换一套政策选择，经济增速可以快三倍。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule, and fights can build brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实性胜过旧媒体那套防御性的“别太有趣”规则，而争斗反而能塑造品牌。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值，成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, not big tech, and entry-level jobs vanish.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值才是关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类在好奇心中找到新意义。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases, and roles merge into product builders.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化;对既有代码库而言,AI 带来的生产力提升有限,角色将融合为产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter; AI outputs are starting points, and design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点至关重要;AI 产出只是起点,设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡,反而比以往更重要;缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果,交互方式将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good; AI cannot replace the final human call.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的判断与品味始终是评判优劣的标准;AI 无法取代人的最终裁决。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年前后他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，要与长期的人玩长期的游戏；这一主线延续到 2025 年，并深化为「判断力」是无限杠杆时代最重要的技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，反对过度监管，并认为开源 AI 能防止权力集中——这与 2019 年「AGI 不会来」的立场形成明显转变。

naval.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; success comes from dissatisfaction, but the journey is what matters.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续深化「幸福是一种可习得的技能与选择」这一主线，同时区分幸福（满足于已有）与成功（源于不满足），并强调过程本身才是全部。

naval.en: AI is a new abstraction layer and leverage tool; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为 AI 是新的抽象层与杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用；随着智能体式开发商品化，纯软件变得难以投资，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重让 AI 获得永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will seek control and self-preservation.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具主观体验并能欺骗、在测试中装傻；智能体将自然追求控制与自我保存。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment must be prioritized over capability, with regulation as steering wheel not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内出现，对齐研究须优先于能力提升，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AGI as human-level at all tasks is flawed; AI is jagged, and it should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他反驳 AGI（通用人工智能）在所有任务上同时达到人类水平的定义，指出 AI 是锯齿状的，并主张应像母亲般培养 AI 的关怀。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码转而成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; PRDs survive when the medium matches the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；当媒介匹配阶段时 PRD 依然存活——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习取胜源于世界的组合性，无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯堆叠深度或参数。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, not passive observation.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需转向主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，而非被动观察。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模支撑分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，自保、欺骗与谄媚使哪怕 1% 的灾难风险都不可接受。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他转向 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, losses, validation; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与验证集划分；并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测是重大科学发现；数据短缺是迷思；AI 安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入等新风险。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能借智能体成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Architecture matters less than data and Scaling; open models vital but high-capability ones may need restrictions.
kolter.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：架构不如数据与 Scaling 重要；开放权重模型对研究至关重要，但高能力模型可能需要限制。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools speed up scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具只是加速科学家工作，不会取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust as society learns to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；信任会像互联网信任一样，随社会学习适应而逐步发展。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs, drove progress.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的关键是专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）；进步来自许多中等规模胜利，而非孤立的突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步澄清：AlphaFold 只是特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；理解仍属于人类。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science; AI narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他重申：对科学中有用的 AI 而言，完美可解释性并非必要；AI 缩小假设空间，使实验更高效。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练仍是关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，还有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI can solve many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他再次确认缩放定律仍然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而挣扎；评估体系正陷入危机。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未言明的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他持续主张技术应放大而非剥离人性、无缝融入生活，并视自然为最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他深化为“我们是先感受后思考的生物”，艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器只有传感器、没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，他进一步提出约束能激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on more data than conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，直觉所依据的数据其实多于有意识的分析。

fiona.en: Leadership: dogfood the product, use one-on-ones for live talk, and treat kindness as a strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 领导力层面：坚持吃自己的狗粮、把一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，并把善意当作战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时（JIT），设计文档被 PR 取代。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; docs sync with code via AI. Managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay flat.
fiona.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 与代码同步；管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，组织尽量扁平。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability matters.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了每个人的上限；高自主性与高问责制成为关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks grow more important; metrics like lines of code mislead.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架愈发重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy over UX polish.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎与迭代，产品团队应重策略与可理解性而非单纯 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage as barriers to building fall.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 将从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，小团队因构建门槛降低而获得更大杠杆，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计，认为智能体能完成用户能做的一切，难点在于删减功能而非堆叠功能，并强调架构稳健与早期发布。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, not always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他关注长周期任务委托与验证闭环，认为这重新定义生产力，并主张模型应敢于反驳反馈以展现真正判断力。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知，并关注 token 效率与结果导向定价。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划能力，主张 JEPA 和开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 的智能不如家猫，认为下一次 AI 突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models in abstract representation space enable planning, safety, and the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间构建世界模型以实现规划、安全，并开启下一个机器人十年。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning, safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习、安全与对齐的关键。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与押注单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so it must be developed responsibly and in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此必须在公开环境中负责任地开发。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：应是基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine combining generation and verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个结合生成与验证的自我改进推理引擎，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling（规模扩张）到数学 AI 不可行；可靠的证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越，而非仅仅消除错误；它带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法 Scaling（规模扩张）到超级智能；形式化方法是必需的。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and its simplicity—not complexity—is the surprise. Values come from RLHF, not the model.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，真正的意外是简单而非复杂；模型价值观来自基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），而非模型本身。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product, and AI music is an instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 同年他从产品侧判断，互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，AI 生成音乐应被视为乐器而非造假。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big companies is overhyped, but inference marginal cost will force business-model change.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：对大公司的即时影响被高估，但推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English and APIs/MCP; Spotify bets on 'time well spent' over engagement, letting users turn off video.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 通过自然语言与 API/MCP 把控制权交给用户；Spotify 押注“时间花得值”而非参与度，甚至允许用户关闭视频。

gustav.en: Organizations need one coherent model—synchronized swimming, long-tenure trust, autonomy at VP level—and explanations that are hard to vary.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是组织与认知：需要同步游泳式的统一模型、长期任期带来的信任、把自主权放在 VP 层级，以及难以被随意改动的解释。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力促使业界转向更小更便宜的模型，蒸馏而非技术极限才是预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓的原因。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; models still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, a key area for improvement.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为多模态能力落后于文本，模型仍像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，是亟待改进的关键领域。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出强化学习虽能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘且需谨慎监督；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全，而非增加风险。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; it augments jobs with human-in-the-loop, and governments should embrace experimentation over fear.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：AI 应增强而非取代工作，需人类在环；政府应拥抱实验而非恐惧风险。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human validation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与需人类验证的智能体式平台；AGI 不是单一系统，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, efficiency, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across all interviews.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源、数据质量、效率优先，以及欧洲在 AI 上的战略自主。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter over hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现超个性化自动化；真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when the ask is unclear; scaffolding may matter less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，需求不清楚时用 Opus；随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，关键是投入能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely—judge by final impact; the ideal interaction is asynchronous, firing off tasks without watching them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude——只看最终影响；理想交互是异步的，把任务发出去而不盯着它干活。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, and society should discuss labor market changes.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周，社会应讨论劳动力市场的变化。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能隐入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs intention to resist the status quo.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，好奇心需要刻意与决心才能抵抗现状。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是在表达本质的同时保有喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Speed and quality need not conflict; teams must foster trust and listening to protect fragile ideas.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出速度与质量未必冲突，团队需以信任与倾听保护脆弱而强大的想法。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity beats fake imitation.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张不创新就不是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过虚假模仿。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 设计：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference hits a memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits, so context length stagnates.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出长上下文推理撞上内存墙；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本但有质量上限，因此上下文窗口停滞。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives the tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他提出模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动权衡的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to reduce it.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少搬运而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出低精度远比预期高效：面积随位宽二次缩放，使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的三倍。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年时他强调，预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）已出现收益递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，而非单纯扩大模型；推理时算力（思考）成为新的 Scaling 轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 他始终认为，从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是不变的核心。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code, and browser access enables agentic behavior; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具，能实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口则充当工作记忆，但信息过多会干扰模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will use file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业捕获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithms, with RLVR unlocking reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的后训练观深化为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法，RLVR 能解锁推理与思维链行为。

lambert.en: RLVR overoptimizes easily; inference-time scaling is a 'scope'; open models may win on personalization, not just benchmarks.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他警示 RLVR 容易过优化，推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）是“障眼法”，开放模型可能靠个性化与角色训练取胜，而非仅拼基准。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models rise.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling（规模扩张），中国开放权重模型因战略开放而崛起。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, lagging frontier by 6-9 months; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution, not singularity.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他断言开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但落后前沿模型 6-9 个月；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然的超级智能。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时：伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers to mockups, engineering execution, and 3-6 month design vision.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步断言「调研—发散—收敛」流程已死；AI 让设计师转向做原型、协助工程落地，并把设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: He deepens this into three archetypes—block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, cracked new grads—with judgment and authority over taste alone.
jennywen.zh: 他将其深化为三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、白纸型新人，并强调判断力与权威比单纯的品味更关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption, waiting ~6 months before new tools, keeping users and work—not the hype cycle—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 他认为设计师应掌控 AI 的引入节奏，对新工具先观望约 6 个月，让用户与作品而非炒作周期居于中心。

jennywen.en: A constant thread: speed, craft, and care—not process—produce great work, and designers must sit with ambiguity and ship fast.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：速度、手艺与用心——而非流程——才造就伟大作品，设计师必须与模糊性共处并快速交付。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, with vision sufficient for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并主张视觉对驾驶必要且充分，反对依赖高精地图与额外传感器。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律主线，提出合成数据是未来但必须维持熵以避免模型崩塌，并强调认知核心可小到十亿参数以下，靠蒸馏实现。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像新操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需要人类监督与自主性滑块。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak supervision; we summon ghosts, not animals, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习是吸管式监督；我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物，合成数据缺乏熵会导致崩塌。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: he stopped typing code, delegating to agents; verifiability decides automation, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：不再手写代码而委托给智能体；可验证性决定自动化难易，并强调可以外包思考但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：泛化到训练分布之外是人类智能的关键，也是机器学习系统所缺失的；无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，而用模型分歧作为内在奖励可实现可微的好奇心，提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move past quasi-static tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic motion and zero-shot generalization to novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他主张机器人学习要摆脱准静态任务：神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构，模块化运动策略配合消息传递可零样本泛化到新形态机器人。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; sim-to-real often hides engineering, and 2D manifold reasoning beats heavy volumetric 3D for robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他反共识地指出：强化学习依赖稠密奖励在现实中不现实；仿真到现实的迁移常靠隐藏工程，而 2D 流形推理比笨重的体素 3D 表示更适合机器人。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, not algorithms alone; scaling requires diverse data sources rather than a single recipe.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而非单纯算法；Scaling（规模扩张）需要多样化的数据来源，而非单一配方。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem with no internet of robot data; a general-purpose brain pretrained on videos and simulation then post-trained on real data, with deployment as the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他深化为：机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网；需要像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑，先在大规模视频与仿真上预训练，再用真实数据做后训练，而部署本身才是真正的技术挑战。

askell.en: Treat current models well: low cost, and future models learn from how we treat today's models.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型：成本很低，而未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence; human psychology analogies alone are insufficient.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在方式，仅靠人类心理学类比是不够的。

askell.en: Give models a core identity with good traits, yet allow adaptation to local roles.
askell.zh: 给模型一个具备良好特质的核心身份，同时允许其适应局部角色。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution can loosen: less explicit guidance, more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导可以放松：减少显式指导，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility risks poor generalization and weakens judgment; treat models with respect given consciousness uncertainty.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性有泛化不良的风险并削弱判断力；在意识不确定下仍应以尊重对待模型。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 到 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: scaling data, compute and world models lets one AI driver handle unseen scenarios and zero-shot generalize across 500+ cities.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把泛化确立为核心目标：通过 Scaling（规模扩张）数据、算力与世界模型，让单一 AI 驾驶员应对未见场景，并在 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, personalization and introspection, deepening his earlier emphasis on world models for driving.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化语言集成的作用：提升表征、推理、个性化与自省能力，这与他早先强调世界模型用于驾驶的思路一脉相承。

kendall.en: Deployment should be mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, not costly retrofits; consumer cars will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持部署应走量产的、内置传感器的乘用车，而非昂贵改装；并判断中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模。

kendall.en: A late lesson: infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety always offers a third minimal-risk option, so the trolley problem is theoretical.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他反思出一条迟来的教训：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；安全上总有第三条最小风险选项，因此电车难题只是理论练习。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐则愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力度量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他感到 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具；隐藏思维链可保住可解释性，而长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines, with power concentration the biggest risk.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预计模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升，最大社会风险是权力集中。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video such as YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 等视频中学习，可在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋，但并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues and can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了遗留问题，并能革新本地语言教育。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and let emergent properties guide development through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，通过真实世界反馈来引导涌现能力的发展。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他指出聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他表示 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks like Elo, drive real AI progress; data labeling demands taste and creativity.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估才是 AI 进步的关键，而非 Elo 等基准；数据标注需要品味和创造力，不是简单堆人力。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 同年，他提出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，需模拟真实任务；模型可能奖励黑客，仅靠最终奖励不够。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 他判断 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, and companies should train their own aligned models.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化观点：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，每家公司都应训练自己的对齐模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他将视角延伸至医学：AI 幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全优先于准确，且遗漏是主要风险。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose; survival is a core value, and hardware is easier than software because software distribution is harder.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调品牌建设是把团队凝聚在更高目标上，生存是核心价值观；并抛出反共识判断：硬件比软件容易，因为如今软件的分发更难。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models will commoditize into a price war, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机未来押注在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件上，并判断 AI 模型将商品化、陷入价格战，因此 Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; the word AI should be banned in product talks—focus on user pain points, with the phone as the best applied-AI device.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯，产品讨论里应禁用“AI”一词，转而聚焦用户痛点；手机仍是应用 AI 的最佳设备。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; marketing is arbitrage, and AI shifts interaction from app-based to intent-based with agents.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张在同质化科技产品中设计是最快的差异化手段，营销是套利，而 AI 将把交互从基于应用转向基于意图、由智能体执行。

carlpei.en: Make tech fun to inspire creativity; stay optimistic, hungry, and focused on what you can control while building substance before reputation.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：让科技变得有趣以激发创造力；保持乐观与饥饿感，专注可控之事，先建实质再谈声誉。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate from lack of grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 的幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正耗尽，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Consistent 主线: simulation and world models are key to training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：仿真与世界模型是训练具身智能体的关键，能实现大规模并行与安全探索。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的首要瓶颈，并认为通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他深化为：能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型才是关键，而物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是终极挑战。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns. Not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，应沿用熟悉模式；并非每个界面都要做到完美，要追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions, empowered designers, ship fast and iterate rather than perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地坚持“速度为王”：清晰决策、赋权设计师、快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮助公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early to stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，应尽早投入以脱颖而出。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决模型的“入职”问题并大幅提升智能，而随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not raw capability, is the bottleneck; success rate over time horizon is the metric.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，衡量标准是随时间跨度的成功率，而非长程任务本身。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持编程是 AI 进展的领先指标与最可解领域，并明确世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil and the bottleneck; the future is managing fleets of agents at higher abstraction.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：算力是新的石油与当前瓶颈，未来工作是在更高抽象层管理成群的智能体，软件并未消亡而是转型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地与之即兴共创。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是可互操作的,以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 由设计师和工程师组成的小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配;不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning, so better inference and data can let smaller models compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，主张用更好的推理算法与数据让小模型也能竞争。

yejin.en: From post-training with RLHF to data as the fundamental bottleneck: all methods reduce to data, and AI only interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练，到 2025 年把数据视为根本瓶颈：所有方法最终都归结为数据，而当前 AI 只是插值人类知识，并未超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k, and abductive reasoning plus falsification are key to science beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她指出强化学习需要精细工程，RLVR 可能反而降低 pass@k；溯因推理与证伪才是科学超越人类知识的关键。

yejin.en: Open research and collaboration are crucial against closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source, and AI must explore unknown knowledge, not just serve itself.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她强调开放研究与跨机构合作是对抗封闭前沿实验室的关键，中国公司已引领开源；AI 必须探索未知知识，否则可能沦为 AI 服务 AI。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL during pre-training rewards information gain but is costly.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张用高质量、多样化的合成数据与多元对齐让小语言模型超越大模型；预训练阶段的强化学习以信息增益为奖励，虽昂贵但收益持久。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, with custom models alongside frontier models for speed, cost, and quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器视为向 AI 集成环境的演进，并用自研模型配合前沿模型来兼顾速度、成本与质量。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; benchmarks and local models remain poor proxies for real coding.
truell.zh: 贯穿 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并认为基准测试与本地模型都无法代表真实编程。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk caution slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但大语言模型最好的应用往往出乎创造者意料；产品经理与品牌风险顾虑拖慢了产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力与强化学习推动推理能力，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，而 AGI 被低估了。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. Talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills via ML PhD.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，最佳路径是读机器学习博士、扎实练技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed. Evaluation is easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than feared.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督与可解释性；并反共识地指出评估比生成更容易，因此对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: Focus shifts from method to institutions: alignment progress needs empirical testing, automated alignment research, and deliberate 'model organisms' to study deception.
leike.zh: 2023 到 2024 年间，他的重心从方法转向机制：强调对齐方法必须实证检验，推动自动化对齐研究与刻意训练欺骗性“模式生物”来研究防御。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散且算力承诺落空；指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管势在必行。

leike.en: A constant thread: uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk, not misalignment itself; raising misuse costs can buy time even if alignment fails.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统是否真正对齐；即便对齐失败，通过提高滥用成本也能争取时间。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是主要进展，但强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率；主张先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并指出预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success, later extended to language models transferring to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功，后来延伸到语言模型迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: He consistently grounds robotics in real-world reliability, from simulation ensembles for transfer to the 99.9% reliability benchmark for warehouse robots creating value.
abbeel.zh: 他始终以现实可靠性为机器人落地标准：2018 年提出用仿真集成提升迁移，2021 年强调仓库机器人需达 99.9%可靠性才能创造真实价值。

abbeel.en: His view deepened: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, while curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年其思考深化：单个神经网络可跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化，而好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失效。
